facts.fact: BurundiPay enables real-time 24/7 transfers and payments from bank accounts and mobile wallets, with full interoperability across banks, microfinance institutions and payment providers.
BurundiPay is described as the national instant payment system connecting commercial banks, microfinance institutions and payment service providers in a single network, also reachable by USSD.

systems.platform: national instant payment system, ISO 20022, USSD
systems.owner: Banque de la Republique du Burundi
